topic: 学习目标与学习习惯 · Independent new scenario: an adult learner choosing an English course
grammarFocus: 一般现在时与现在进行时；频率副词；do / does 问句。 Teach the new rule in Chinese, then provide at least 8 distinct grammar questions in new sentences. Distinguish a newly taught form from revision. All main reading/listening question prompts and options must be English, with short A0/A1 English prompts. Chinese explanations are allowed. Preserve a coherent new scenario; do not rename an earlier text, reuse its facts or reveal answers in question stems.
sourcePolicy: Project-original scenario; simulated figures and people; no copied official test, textbook, GitHub PDF or third-party audio.
title: Choosing an Evening English Course
instructions: 阅读下面的短文，回答8个问题。问题类型包括单选、填空和判断（True/False/Not Given）。填空答案必须来自原文，且不超过规定字数。所有题目和选项均为英文，解释为中文。本材料为模拟教学练习，不是官方雅思考试。
passage:
A
Mei is a 28-year-old office worker in Shanghai. She wants to improve her English for her job. Every Monday and Wednesday evening, she looks at English course websites on her phone. She usually studies at home after dinner. She is not happy with her speaking, so she wants a class with a teacher.

B
This week, Mei is trying a new evening course at a small school near her office. The class is on Tuesdays and Thursdays, from 7:00 to 8:30. There are eight students in the class. The teacher, Mr. Lee, speaks slowly and clearly. He often asks questions, and the students answer in English. Mei likes the class because she can speak a lot.

C
Mei has a busy week. On Monday, she works late and does not go to the class. On Tuesday, she goes to the class and takes notes. On Wednesday, she reviews her notes for 20 minutes. On Thursday, she goes to the class again. She sometimes listens to English podcasts on the bus. She rarely watches English movies because she is tired in the evening. She never misses the class on Tuesdays and Thursdays.

D
Now Mei is thinking about next month. She wants to take a speaking test. She is practicing with a friend on Saturday mornings. She is also saving money for a new course. She says, “I am learning a lot, and I am feeling more confident.”

questions.prompt: What does Mei want to improve?
questions.explanation: 原文A段说“She wants to improve her English for her job.”，所以选“Her English for her job”。
questions.evidence: She wants to improve her English for her job.

questions.prompt: When is Mei's new evening course?
questions.explanation: 原文B段说“The class is on Tuesdays and Thursdays, from 7:00 to 8:30.”，所以选“On Tuesdays and Thursdays”。
questions.evidence: The class is on Tuesdays and Thursdays, from 7:00 to 8:30.

questions.prompt: How many students are in the class? (Write one word or a number.)
questions.explanation: 原文B段说“There are eight students in the class.”，所以答案是eight或8。
questions.evidence: There are eight students in the class.

questions.prompt: What does Mei do on Wednesday?
options: She reviews her notes for 20 minutes.
answers: She reviews her notes for 20 minutes.
questions.explanation: 原文C段说“On Wednesday, she reviews her notes for 20 minutes.”，所以选“She reviews her notes for 20 minutes.”。
questions.evidence: On Wednesday, she reviews her notes for 20 minutes.

questions.prompt: How often does Mei listen to English podcasts on the bus?
questions.explanation: 原文C段说“She sometimes listens to English podcasts on the bus.”，所以选“Sometimes”。
questions.evidence: She sometimes listens to English podcasts on the bus.

questions.prompt: Mei rarely watches English movies because she is tired in the evening.
questions.explanation: 原文C段明确说“She rarely watches English movies because she is tired in the evening.”，与题目一致，所以选True。
questions.evidence: She rarely watches English movies because she is tired in the evening.

questions.prompt: Mei is practicing with a friend on Saturday mornings.
questions.explanation: 原文D段说“She is practicing with a friend on Saturday mornings.”，与题目一致，所以选True。
questions.evidence: She is practicing with a friend on Saturday mornings.

questions.prompt: Mei never misses the class on Tuesdays and Thursdays.
questions.explanation: 原文C段最后一句说“She never misses the class on Tuesdays and Thursdays.”，与题目一致，所以选True。
questions.evidence: She never misses the class on Tuesdays and Thursdays.

grammar.title: 一般现在时与现在进行时；频率副词；do/does 问句
grammar.explanation: 一般现在时表示经常发生的动作或习惯，常与 always, usually, often, sometimes, rarely, never 等频率副词连用。主语是 he/she/it 时，动词要加 -s 或 -es。现在进行时表示现在正在进行的动作，结构是 am/is/are + 动词-ing。一般现在时的问句用 do/does 开头：Do you...? Does she...? 注意：does 后面的动词用原形。
grammar.example: She usually studies at home after dinner. / She is practicing with a friend on Saturday mornings. / He often asks questions, and the students answer in English.

questions.prompt: My brother ___ to work by bus every day.
questions.explanation: every day 表示习惯，用一般现在时；主语 My brother 是第三人称单数，动词加 -es，所以选 goes。
questions.evidence: She usually studies at home after dinner.

questions.prompt: Look! The children ___ in the park now.
questions.explanation: now 表示现在正在进行，用现在进行时；主语 The children 是复数，用 are + 动词-ing，所以选 are playing。
questions.evidence: She is practicing with a friend on Saturday mornings.

questions.explanation: 一般现在时问句用 Does 开头，主语 she 是第三人称单数，后面的动词用原形 sing，所以选 Does; sing。
questions.evidence: He often asks questions, and the students answer in English.

questions.prompt: I ___ watch TV in the morning.
questions.explanation: 一般现在时否定句用 don't + 动词原形；主语 I 用 don't，所以选 don't。
questions.evidence: She rarely watches English movies because she is tired in the evening.

questions.prompt: He ___ late for class. He is always on time.
questions.explanation: 频率副词 never 放在 be 动词之后，所以是 is never late，选 is never。
questions.evidence: She never misses the class on Tuesdays and Thursdays.

questions.explanation: at the moment 表示现在正在进行，用现在进行时；主语 They 是复数，用 are + 动词-ing，所以选 are having。
questions.evidence: She is also saving money for a new course.

questions.explanation: 一般现在时问句，主语 your parents 是复数，用 Do 开头，动词用原形 live，所以选 Do; live。
questions.evidence: He often asks questions, and the students answer in English.

questions.explanation: every morning 表示习惯，用一般现在时；主语 She 是第三人称单数，动词加 -s，所以选 drinks。
questions.evidence: She usually studies at home after dinner.
